# Agility Accountants & Advisors

> CPA-led operational diagnostics and advisory for Maryland small businesses. Agility normalizes a business's financials, benchmarks them against industry-average and best-in-class performance, and delivers a prioritized plan to improve margin and cash flow. Led by Robert O'Connor, CPA, based in Baltimore, Maryland.

Agility Accountants & Advisors is a Baltimore, Maryland accounting and advisory firm. Unlike a traditional bookkeeper, Agility turns clean books into an operational performance diagnostic: it compares a client's numbers against both the industry average and the best operators in their industry, identifies exactly where the business is losing margin or cash, and delivers a clear, prioritized monthly plan to fix it. The firm is led by Robert O'Connor, a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

Contact: phone +1-410-456-2433, email roconnor@agility-accountants.com, Baltimore, Maryland.

## What makes Agility different
- CPA-led, not a non-credentialed bookkeeping service.
- Benchmarks clients against industry-average AND best-in-class performance, not just generic averages.
- Translates financial data into specific, prioritized operational actions a non-accountant owner can act on.
- Focus on improving margin, cash flow, and confident growth.

## Services
- [Operational Diagnostic & Benchmarking](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/financial-analysis.html): The flagship monthly engagement. Normalizes financials, benchmarks against industry-average and best-in-class, and delivers a prioritized improvement plan.
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Clean, CPA-reviewed books that power the diagnostic.
- [Tax Planning](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/plan.html): Strategic planning to minimize tax liability.
- [Tax Preparation](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Tax preparation for individuals and businesses.
- [Business Formation / Reorganization](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Guidance on entity structure.
- [Estate Planning](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Asset and legacy protection.
- [Business Funding](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/business-funding.html): Financing guidance for growing businesses.

## Industries served
Maryland small businesses across many industries, with particular depth in construction and contractors (job costing, subcontractor analysis, margin benchmarking) and restaurants (prime cost, food and labor cost benchmarking).
